entry.title: Milwaukee Brewers staff and front office: If Matt Arnold called in sick and you were Brewers GM for the day, would any of these non-tender candidates intrigue you? www.mlb.com/news/non-ten...

Dustin May: The Dodgers traded Dustin May to the Red Sox at the 2025 trade deadline rather than put him in the bullpen. He is 8-13, 4.81 in 37 games/36 starts with three teams since. May agreed to a three-year/$52.5 million deal with the White Sox today. Get your kid pitching lessons.
Ryan Walker: The Giants traded RHP Ryan Walker to the Brewers in exchange for Minor League RHPs Blake Holub and Gavin Perry.

William Contreras: The No. 1 question Matt Arnold was asked at the GM Meetings this week: "Are you going to trade William Contreras?" You know he's not going to answer directly, so have fun parsing what he *did* say: www.mlb.com/brewers/news...
Milwaukee Brewers offseason notes: Free agents Arbitration eligibles 40-man adds After a fun October, the offseason is here. Catch up on the Brewers’ to-do list: www.mlb.com/news/brewers...

Brice Turang: “You going to let $1 million stand in the way of signing a Hall of Famer?" One of of my favorite tales of the '26 Brewers, from Bob Nightengale early in the season. Did Brice Turang really say it? We got to witness him and Matt Arnold hash it out. www.mlb.com/brewers/news...
